5 Dependencies to other Functional Clusters
This chapter provides an overview of the dependencies to other Functional Clusters
in the AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform. Section 5.1 “Provided Interfaces” lists the inter-
faces provided by Intrusion Detection System Mananger to other Functional Clusters.
Section 5.2 “Required Interfaces” lists the interfaces required by Intrusion Detection
System Mananger.
A detailed technical architecture documentation of the AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform is
provided in [6].
